roll_convention: legs and palps: local X = hinge axis, +X rotation = more flexion on both sides (R = X-mirror of L); body bones local X ~ world +X; root, cog and ground point up (+Z)

control_rig.legs: ctl_<S>_Leg<n>_IK at the foot tip (child of ctl_root) carries the ankle target; 2-bone IK on _02 femur + _03 tibia with ctl_<S>_Leg<n>_pole (child of ctl_cog); _04 tarsus Damped Track to the IK control
control_rig.switches: ik_leg_L1 .. ik_leg_R4 on the control object (1 = IK, 0 = FK)
control_rig.body: ctl_cog raises, lowers and tilts the body with the feet planted

W07_shroud_spinner.removed_from_tripo_glb: two loose rear-leg fragments, 286 verts / 452 tris (G1)

usable_ranges.abdomen_01: pitch/yaw +-10 deg (the Tripo abdomen already overlaps the head plate at rest); 15 deg tested at 1.87x
usable_ranges.abdomen_02: curl <= ~12 deg (spinneret cap); big abdomen swings go on abdomen_01
usable_ranges.ctl_cog: -0.30 m (body to the ground) tested, 1.62x; turn +-20 deg <= 1.48x
usable_ranges.fangs / palps: fang X -25 deg, Y -+30 deg with Palp_01 X -20, Palp_02 X -45 tested, 2.69x at the palp apex
usable_ranges.<S>_Leg<n>_01 coxa: FK only, small rotations: big coxa lifts push into the sternum; lift legs with the IK control

notes: Family A (multi-leg): 8 legs x 4 segments (_01 coxa, _02 femur, _03 tibia, _04 tarsus), 2 palps x 2, 2 fangs. Clips are made at R6 on the control rig and baked onto these bones at R8.
The control rig is not exported: it drives the runtime bones through FollowControl (Copy Transforms) constraints in the source .blend only.
Sockets carry no weights: root = ground origin, cog = body, ground, hit_origin, fx_head, fx_abdomen, fx_spinneret (silk).
Leg1 and Leg2 of each side are fused in the Tripo mesh: their shared knob is rigid to the cephalothorax.
